userStories.title: Add Core Web Vitals optimization: hero image priority and lazy-loading
userStories.description: The Hero component (Hero.tsx) likely uses a large banner image that is the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) element. Without the `priority` prop on the Next.js Image component, the hero image is lazy-loaded, causing LCP scores above 4s on mobile — a Google ranking signal. Additionally, below-fold images should be explicitly lazy-loaded and sized with the `sizes` attribute to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). Target: LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero image uses <Image priority> prop (no lazy loading on LCP element)
